description: Colossal Skyturtle's Channel ability is activated from hand (discarding the card as its own cost) and returns a target card from the graveyard to hand - exercising both the Channel activated-ability-from-a-non-battlefield-zone mechanic (CR 702.48) and graveyard-to-hand movement in one fixture.
artificial_state_elements: Demonic Tutor in the graveyard is an arbitrary stand-in recursion target - any card would do.
2 Forest is more mana than the {2}{G} channel cost strictly requires, to avoid payment ambiguity.
material_characteristics: Channel is an activated ability that functions from hand, not the battlefield (CR 702.48a), and discarding the card is part of its cost
Colossal Skyturtle is discarded (not milled or sacrificed) as part of paying the channel cost, so it itself ends up in the graveyard, not returned by its own ability
The targeted card moves from graveyard to hand, a genuine zone change subject to state-based/triggered effects that key off either zone
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the recursion target - any graveyard card is a legal target for this specific channel ability
All board state not directly involved in the activation

legal_actions: Activate Colossal Skyturtle's Channel ability ({2}{G}, discard this card): return Demonic Tutor from graveyard to hand
illegal_actions_to_reject: Activating the channel ability without discarding Colossal Skyturtle - discarding it is the cost, not a side effect
Casting Colossal Skyturtle as a creature spell and also activating channel in the same instance - channel can only be activated from hand, and once cast as a spell it's no longer in hand
expected.outcome_if_resolved: Colossal Skyturtle discarded to the graveyard; Demonic Tutor moves from graveyard to hand.
